list.title: Śivapadam Recitation — Samavedam Shanmukha Sharma
list.desc: Recited 10 Śivapadam poems composed by the renowned scholar in his presence during his Sydney visit. Received a special memento in recognition.

list.title: Soundaryalaharī Pārāyaṇa — Ayyappa Temple
list.desc: Performed the complete pārāyaṇa of Soundaryalaharī (100 verses) at Sydney Ayyappa Temple across the nine sacred nights of Navarātri.

list.title: Bhagavad Gītā — Ṣaṣṭipūrti Mahōtsavam
list.desc: Chanted the complete Śrīmad Bhagavad Gītā on the occasion of Paṇḍit Rishikesh Bhattar's Ṣaṣṭipūrti (60th Birthday) Mahōtsavam — all 700 verses as a devotional offering.

list.title: Sanskrit Olympiad — 1st Place in Australia
list.desc: Achieved 1st place in Australia in the National Sanskrit Olympiad. Previously secured All India Rank 266 — two consecutive years of national-level recognition.

list.title: Gold Medal — Bhagavad Gītā 700 Verses
list.desc: Awarded the Gold Medal for memorising and reciting all 700 verses of the Śrīmad Bhagavad Gītā by the revered Mysore Datta Peetham.

list.title: Taṭavarti Kalyāṇ Avadānam
list.desc: Participated as the Aprastuta Prasaṅga Pṛcchakudu (off-topic questioner) in the celebrated scholar's prestigious avadānam performance.

list.title: Mānava Kathā & Gajendra Mokṣam — Winner
list.desc: Won prizes in both Mānava Kathā and Gajendra Mokṣam competitions under the guidance of Vaddiparti Padmakar.

list.title: Rāmāyaṇa & Daśāvatāra — Prizes
list.desc: Multiple prizes in Rāmāyaṇa and Daśāvatāra storytelling competitions, and poetry competitions by Pranava Peetham.

list.title: 'Para Bhāṣa Lekundā Telugu Lo' — Winner
list.desc: Won this Telugu language purity competition at the remarkable age of 3–4 — the earliest sign of his extraordinary linguistic gift.
